[D16:3] Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?
[D16:4] Jolene: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction.
[D16:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man holding a snake on his arm
[D16:5] Deborah: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?
[D16:6] Jolene: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
[D16:7] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.
[D16:8] Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:42] Deborah: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!
[D4:43] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll definitely stay in touch. Bye, take care and keep shining!

Session date: 9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023
[D5:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.
[D5:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?
[D5:3] Jolene: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.
[D5:4] Deborah: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?
[D5:5] Jolene: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.
[D5:6] Deborah: Let's go into more detail.
[D5:7] Jolene:  Green tech could really make a difference in disadvantaged areas. I'd like to look into it and see how I can contribute. Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?
[D5:8] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others. They would benefit a lot from your knowledge. Have you thought of a plan yet?
[D5:9] Jolene: Haven't finished planning yet but I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops. We could even invite engineers as guest speakers to show kids their career options.
[D5:10] Deborah: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view. Have you reached out to any schools or centers yet?
[D5:11] Jolene: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!
[D5:12] Deborah: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!
[D5:13] Jolene: I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner.
[D5:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes
[D5:14] Deborah: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.
[D5:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!
[D5:16] Deborah: You're awesome too! Take care!
[D5:17] Jolene: Stay safe!
Session date: 4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023
[D6:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah, totally buzzing! Had a great night out last night - dinner, and drinks with my friends. So glad I got to let my hair down. You?
[D6:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plate of food and a glass of wine
[D6:2] Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too.
[D6:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a garden with a bunch of flowers in buckets
[D6:3] Jolene: Wow, those flowers are beautiful! What type are they? It looks so peaceful there.
[D6:4] Deborah: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.
[D6:5] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
[D6:6] Deborah: Thanks for the kind words. It's been tough, but I'm comforted by remembering our time together. It reminds me of how special life is.
[D6:7] Jolene: Memories can give us so much comfort and joy.
[D6:8] Deborah: Memories keep our loved ones close. This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one. We had such a great time! Every time I see it, I can't help but smile.
[D6:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women are riding on a motorcycle on a dirt road
[D6:9] Jolene: Wow, looks like a great trip! Where else have you traveled?
[D6:10] Deborah: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga.
[D6:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a swing on a beach with a blue sky
[D6:11] Jolene: Wow, that's great! Is yoga on the beach a thing? I've been wanting to try it.
[D6:12] Deborah: The sound of the waves and the fresh air is wonderful!
[D6:13] Jolene: I'll definitely give it a go! It sounds peaceful. Thanks!
[D6:14] Deborah: Let me know how it goes. Enjoy it!
[D6:15] Jolene: I'll keep you posted if I decide to go there.
[D6:16] Deborah: Take care!
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:1] Jolene: Hi Deborah, it's been a while! Since we last talked, so much has happened. Balancing engineering school with my partner's video games is quite a feat. But I'm also setting aside time for myself, doing yoga and meditation. It helps give me calm amidst the craziness.
[D7:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?
[D7:3] Jolene: They seriously saved me. I chill out and gain perspective when I do yoga. Afterward, I'm more alert and motivated. Here is my last photo.
[D7:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose
[D7:4] Deborah: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?
[D7:5] Jolene: He started joining me sometimes, which is nice for bonding and relaxing. It's brought us closer. This is just our random photo.
[D7:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman holding hands with rings on them
[D7:6] Deborah: Aw, that's wonderful! How long have you been married?
[D7:7] Jolene: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years. We're taking it slow and loving the ride. This ring on his hand is just a decoration, not a wedding ring.
[D7:8] Deborah: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?
[D7:9] Jolene: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!
[D7:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book and a calculator on a table
[D7:10] Deborah: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?
[D7:11] Jolene: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it.
[D7:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.
